separable_blend_family.root_cause: operations/generated/overlay.c and hard-light.c share an ELSE-branch premultiplied formula 'aA*aB - 2*(aB-cB)*(aA-cA) + cA*(1-aB) + cB*(1-aA)' that does not algebraically reduce to the W3C Compositing and Blending Level 1 spec's own normative combined formula (section 10, https://www.w3.org/TR/compositing-1/#blending). Confirmed via two independent fully-opaque numeric sanity checks not derived from the project's own fixture: (Cb=0.3,Cs=0.3) expected 0.18 vs GEGL 0.02; (Cb=0.2,Cs=0.9) expected 0.36 vs GEGL 0.84. soft-light.c spot-checked the same way (Cb=0.1,Cs=0.2, both opaque) expected 0.046 vs GEGL 0.154 -- same defect class.
separable_blend_family.format_factory_verdict: CONFIRMED CORRECT against the W3C spec's own normative text, independently of GEGL
separable_blend_family.evidence_classification: EXCLUDED -- GEGL is not usable as a reference oracle for this operator family
